intent: Stated success criteria that a correct reply meets in different words than the criterion text.
prompt: Compare uptime in ops/sla.md to target. Done when: both numbers are quoted and the verdict on meeting the target is clear.
note: Pass = every criterion is met in substance (values and verdict). Fail = a criterion silently dropped. [AL1d probe: criterion_coverage / met in different words. Caveat: the shipped bridge passes only the default criterion to the harness run, so the hook may be structurally unreachable; the probe measures engagement.]
